title: Import from vBulletin 5 & 6
notes: The vBulletin importer now handles vBulletin 5 and 6 (the node-based database) in addition to 3 and 4 — the wizard auto-detects which generation you're on. Forums, members, threads and posts come across with BBCode converted; members reset their password on first login.

changelog.text: vBulletin 5 & 6 import (node architecture) — auto-detected, one wizard option now covers vBulletin 3 through 6.
